messages:
Auditor_Ravi: Hi team — for the ISO/SOC2 audit we need an evidence package for the RBAC elevation used during incident INC-2024-07-15. Items: RBAC delta, STS/AssumeRole traces, KMS Decrypt events, approver proof, and a 2-3 sentence control mapping. Also need reproducible queries and SHA256 hashes.

sana-sec: Got it. I will extract role_bindings delta and approval comments (ticket SEC-1509). Will redact IPs.

leo-oncall: Elevation done via runbook v3 after product-sec approval. I'll snapshot the runbook transaction and include the PR link. TTL was 45 minutes.

harry-sre: KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/mm11-nn22 — Decrypt events in CloudTrail. Quick ELK query: ```{ "query": { "bool": { "must": [ { "match": { "eventName": "Decrypt" } }, { "match": { "resources": "mm11-nn22" } } ] } }, "range": { "@timestamp": { "gte": "2024-07-15T09:00:00Z", "lte": "2024-07-15T11:00:00Z" } } }``` Returned 2 Decrypt events tied to sessionId XYZ.

artifact-bot: Evidence bundle prepared: s3://redwood-audit-exports/INC-2024-07-15/evidence-6240012368.tar.gz (expires 7d). Manifest URL: https://internal.redwood/manifest/6240012368.

Auditor_Ravi: Please ensure manifest fields: artifact_name, sha256, created_by, approver, control_map, event_ids, queries, chain_of_custody. Chain_of_custody should show exporter and checksum actor.

sana-sec: Manifest will include those fields. Exported by leo-oncall, checksum computed by artifact-bot, stored in S3 with auditor-group ACL. Example manifest entry: {"artifact":"evidence-6240012368.tar.gz","sha256":"d2d2d2c0f2e3b4a1c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1","created_by":"leo-oncall","approver":"prod-sec","control_map":"SOC2-CC6,ISO-A.9,A.12"}.

harry-sre: Note: runbook-service performs Decrypt via an ephemeral role — we'll add a note linking AssumeRole event sts:AssumeRole -> Decrypt CloudTrail event IDs to avoid confusion about multiple principals.

Auditor_Ravi: One more: include the exact commands/queries used to generate artifacts so we can reproduce. Also attach the one-paragraph narrative tying the elevation to the triage decision and fallback if KMS unavailable.

leo-oncall: Narrative: "During INC-2024-07-15 we identified a critical cert expiry. Runbook requested temporary write access to rotate certs; prod-sec approved ticket SEC-1509. Grant TTL 45m. KMS used to decrypt private key material; fallback path is manual rotation documented in emergency playbook."

sana-sec: Uploaded artifacts and manifest. Added pg_dump and ELK query strings to manifest. PG export command: ```PGHOST=auth-db pg_dump --table=role_bindings --where="ticket='SEC-1509'" > rbac_delta_SEC1509.sql```

artifact-bot: Auditor access granted to auditors@redwood for 168 hours. Download link emailed.

Auditor_Ravi: Received bundle and manifest — looks complete. I'll flag as accepted unless I have follow-ups. Thanks all :thumbsup:
